result.instructions: Tools for Invoice Office, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the invoices created in October 2026."; "Find the customer with the name Acme and show their contact details."; "List the quotes that have no matching invoice yet.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Invoice Office data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run invoiceoffice_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run invoiceoffice_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run invoiceoffice_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. invoiceoffice_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customer accounts (companies and persons) in the Invoice Office account, one page at a time. Invoice Office API: GET /api/v1/account/customers.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer account by id, with its address and contact fields. Invoice Office API: GET /api/v1/account/customers/{id}.

id.description: Record id, as returned by the matching list tool.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List supplier accounts, one page at a time. Invoice Office API: GET /api/v1/account/suppliers.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier account by id. Invoice Office API: GET /api/v1/account/suppliers/{id}.

id.description: Record id, as returned by the matching list tool.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices, one page at a time. Filter by document number or by creation date range (yyyy-mm-dd). Invoice Office API: GET /api/v1/document/document_invoices.

document_number.description: Filter by the document number, as shown on the document.

created_after.description: Only invoices created on or after this date.

created_before.description: Only invoices created on or before this date.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one sales invoice by id, with its totals, customer and lines. Invoice Office API: GET /api/v1/document/document_invoices/{id}.

id.description: Record id, as returned by the matching list tool.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: List quotes (offers), one page at a time, optionally by document number. Invoice Office API: GET /api/v1/document/document_quotes.

document_number.description: Filter by the document number, as shown on the document.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_get_quote

document_number.description: Filter by the document number, as shown on the document.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_list_products

tools.name: invoiceoffice_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product or service by id. Invoice Office API: GET /api/v1/product/products/{id}.

id.description: Record id, as returned by the matching list tool.

tools.name: invoiceoffice_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer account in the Invoice Office account. Writes a new record each time it runs, so do not retry blindly. Invoice Office API: POST /api/v1/account/customers.

is_person.description: True for a private person, false for a company.

billing_country_code.description: Two-letter country code, for example NL.
